name: barbell close grip biceps curl
description: Barbell curl with hands placed close together. This grip puts extra emphasis on the outer part of the biceps.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands closer than shoulder width.
Keep your elbows tucked against your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Squeeze your biceps at the top for a moment.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.
